integrity: A self-contained mathematical proof and a reproducible finite checker are supplied. Verification of finitely many safe primes is not claimed to prove the infinite theorem. No external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to safe primes p=2q+1; does not prove existence for non-safe primes or infinitely many safe primes, and exact count concerns only first coordinate 2 in the p=3 mod8 branch. Potential literature equivalence remains; mathematical review is not independent.
title: Sharp safe-prime resolution of Sun's four-primitive-root configuration
